# The Thomas B. Fordham Institute

> America's leading education reform think tank providing policy analysis, research, and commentary on K-12 education, teacher workforce development, and federal education policy.

The Fordham Institute is a prominent education policy organization focused on advancing education reform through research-backed analysis and expert commentary. The institute's work spans federal education policy, teacher effectiveness, assessment and testing, and emerging issues like AI in education.

## Key Topics

- Education Policy
- K-12 Education
- Teacher Workforce
- Federal Education
- Education Research
- Teacher Effectiveness
- Standardized Testing
- Assessment and Testing
- AI in Education
- Education Department
- Teacher Diversity
- Education Reform

## About & Leadership

- [The Thomas B. Fordham Institute](https://fordhaminstitute.org): Homepage for America's leading education reform think tank

- [Flypaper Blog](https://fordhaminstitute.org/national/commentary/flypaper-blog): Education policy commentary and analysis by Fordham Institute experts
